newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico's Radio Centro plans U.S. foray.
newsitem.headline: Mexico's Radio Centro plans U.S. foray.

text.p: Mexican radio corporation Grupo Radio Centro said Tuesday that it planned to announce in the next month or so a new venture with an unspecified partner in the United States.
Radio Centro president Adrian Aguirre told a news conference that the company would tie up with a partner to serve Hispanic listeners in the U.S.
He declined to say how much money might be involved but said the project would involve mainly Radio Centro know-how and programming being supplied. A formal announcement would be made in due course.
Radio Centro used to own a stake in U.S. radio stations but sold it in 1995 to help finance the purchase of Radio Red, a Mexican news station.
Aguirre said the new venture should result in Radio Centro having around 50 affiliated U.S. stations within a year.
